Ford delivered a letter (the "Letter") to the Board of Directors of Hilltop Holdings Inc. In the Letter, Mr. Ford raised concerns regarding the Company's current corporate governance arising from Jeremy Ford's simultaneous service as the Company's President/Chief Executive Officer and Chairman of the Board while also serving as plaintiff in pending litigation against Mr. Ford. Mr. Ford stated that, under the circumstances described in the Letter, the Company should, at a minimum, promptly split the President/Chief Executive Officer and Chairman roles as a matter of sound corporate governance, and that the Company's appointment of a lead independent director is not a substitute for doing so. Mr. Ford requested that the Board promptly investigate the matters raised in the Letter. The Reporting Persons may engage in further discussions with the Board, management, other shareholders, or third parties regarding the matters described in the Letter and may take such other actions as they deem appropriate in furtherance of the foregoing, including proposing further changes to the Company's board composition, management, or governance practices.
